base_plan.mining_policy: Control and mining share initial weights, seed, positives, random-negative draws and representative examples. Mining replaces half of TTS/ambient negatives using only verified training windows, with an independent RNG.

comparison.only_difference: Treatment adds completed paired low-level views; control retains original source view set. Class/engine recipe,steps,initial weights,PTQ and validation selection policy match. Additional views intentionally change sampled within-engine windows.

only_intended_difference: Each treatment adds completed paired five-band EQ environmental views to its matching control feature set. Original initialization,optimizer,schedule,class/engine recipe,representative PTQ examples and validation selection are unchanged. Extra views intentionally change within-engine source/window draws.
combination: After independent original-validation checkpoint selection, evaluate exactly the equal mean of the selected dense and temporal treatment heads using the original event grid. No fitted weights or selection from microphone/development scores. Compare both-control and original frozen equal means as separate historical references.
derive_final_plans: Bind completed EQ index/complete hashes after full provenance/pilot audit passes and before fitting; preserve other base_plan fields except experiment description/arm metadata.
gate: Only consider physical/MCU follow-up after frozen original-validation calibration and existing paired/English/Mandarin regression. No acceptance on synthetic variants alone; no inferior replacement of Hi ESP.
